legal_entity: Tangem AG, Reg. No CHE-390.112.525, Baarerstrasse 10, 6300 Zug, Switzerland (footer). Note: the Tangem Pay card programme is operated by Paera LLC, not Tangem AG.
application_conditions: Join via the Tangem app ('To participate in the referral program you need a Tangem Wallet'); unique referral link or code; dashboard in the app. Influencers ('Are you an influencer?') apply through a form (name, e-mail, channel — Blog, Instagram, Telegram, TikTok, X, YouTube —, main channel link, subscriber count, country) for free wallets, event access and custom links/codes. Instructions blog post linked (not read).
paid_action: Purchase of a Tangem Wallet (hardware) via the referral link or code: 'Get paid when someone buys a Tangem Wallet via your referral link.' Tangem Pay card sign-ups or spend are not mentioned.
validation_conditions: Purchase must carry the link or code ('cannot be attributed' otherwise); payment after delivery and after the cancellation window ('no earlier than 30 days' / 'no later than 30 days after each purchase').

commission.model_note: No percentage, flat amount or CPA figure published on the page.

payout.method: USDT on TRC20 'sent directly to your USDT TRC20 wallet address'
payout.frequency: Per purchase, upon delivery, within/after 30 days
payout.holdbacks_note: 30-day window to confirm orders were not cancelled.

rules_note: The page says 'Please take your time to read the Terms and Conditions' but links no referral-specific document (only the general Terms of Use PDF). No channel or country restrictions stated; Tangem 'ships worldwide'.
allowed_countries_note: Not stated; the influencer form has a full country dropdown.

evidence.title: Refer and earn with the Tangem referral program
evidence.excerpt: 'Get a unique referral link, share it with your friends and audience, and earn from every purchase'; 'Get paid when someone buys a Tangem Wallet via your referral link'; USDT TRC20 payout 'no later than 30 days after each purchase'; influencer form; no commission figure; no mention of Tangem Pay.

notes: Identified only — nobody contacted, no application. Pays on hardware-wallet sales, not on the Tangem Pay card; the card programme belongs to Paera LLC, which publishes no partner programme on the pages read. Commission rate unknown.
